declarations.name: AlButton
declarations.description: A button, styled by variant and size. Put a native `<button>` (or an `<a>`) inside it: that works with no JavaScript. The element alone (`<al-button>Save</al-button>`) is presentational: it looks like a button but needs a framework to give it a role, focus and Enter/Space handling.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: The button's look: `primary` (filled), `secondary` (soft), `outline` (bordered), `ghost` (no border until hover) or `destructive` (for deleting).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The button's height and padding.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Shows the button as disabled and stops pointer clicks. In the native-button form, also put `disabled` on the `<button>` so the keyboard and forms skip it.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The kind of the button, for frameworks that render the native `<button>` from it (Alder: `submit` inside a form). It does not change the look.

declarations.name: AlInput
declarations.description: A labelled text input. Alder renders the `<label>`, the `<input>` and the `ul.errors` list inside it.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The input's label text. Alder renders it as a real `<label>` around the input; the stylesheet does not draw this attribute.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: The input's placeholder text, copied onto the `<input>` (drawn in the muted colour).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the input (copied onto the `<input>`) and dims the field.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Marks the field as having errors: the border and focus ring take the destructive colour. Alder's renderer sets it when the field has errors.

attributes.name: help
attributes.description: A hint shown under the input (in the muted colour: the `<small class="help">` child Alder renders, or else drawn from the attribute).

declarations.name: AlTextarea
declarations.description: A labelled multi-line input. Alder renders the `<label>`, the `<textarea>` and the `ul.errors` list inside it.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The textarea's label text. Alder renders it as a real `<label>` around the textarea; the stylesheet does not draw this attribute.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: The textarea's placeholder text, copied onto the `<textarea>`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the textarea (copied onto the `<textarea>`) and dims the field.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Marks the field as having errors: the border and focus ring take the destructive colour. Alder's renderer sets it when the field has errors.

attributes.name: help
attributes.description: A hint shown under the textarea (in the muted colour: the `<small class="help">` child Alder renders, or else drawn from the attribute).

declarations.name: AlSelect
declarations.description: A labelled select. Alder renders the `<label>`, the `<select>` and the `ul.errors` list inside it.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The select's label text. Alder renders it as a real `<label>` around the select; the stylesheet does not draw this attribute.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the select (copied onto the `<select>`) and dims the field.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Marks the field as having errors: the border and focus ring take the destructive colour. Alder's renderer sets it when the field has errors.

attributes.name: help
attributes.description: A hint shown under the select (in the muted colour: the `<small class="help">` child Alder renders, or else drawn from the attribute). Added in alder-ui v0.1.0.

declarations.name: AlCheckbox
declarations.description: A labelled checkbox. Alder renders the `<label>` around the `<input type="checkbox">`, and the `ul.errors` list, inside it.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The checkbox's label text. Alder renders it as a real `<label>` around the checkbox; the stylesheet does not draw this attribute.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the checkbox (copied onto the `<input>`) and dims it.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Marks the field as having errors: the box is outlined in the destructive colour. Alder's renderer sets it when the field has errors. Added in v0.1.1.

attributes.name: help
attributes.description: A hint shown under the checkbox (in the muted colour: the `<small class="help">` child Alder renders, or else drawn from the attribute). Added in alder-ui v0.1.0.

declarations.name: AlTable
declarations.description: Styles the `<table>` inside it: header, borders, padding; scrolls sideways when wide.

attributes.name: striped
attributes.description: Shades every other body row in the muted colour.

attributes.name: dense
attributes.description: Tightens the cell padding.

declarations.name: AlCard
declarations.description: A card: a bordered surface with an optional header, footer and actions, placed by slot.

declarations.name: AlBadge
declarations.description: A small pill for a status or a count.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: The badge's look: `default` (filled), `secondary` (soft), `outline` (bordered) or `destructive`.

declarations.name: AlAlert
declarations.description: A message box for information, success, a warning or an error. Write `role="alert"` or `role="status"` on it.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: The alert's kind, which sets its colours: `info`, `success`, `warning` or `destructive`.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The alert's heading, drawn in bold above the message. (Renamed from `title` in v0.1.1: `title` is the global tooltip attribute.)

attributes.name: dismissible
attributes.description: Makes room for a dismiss button; the optional `al-alert.js` module adds the button.

declarations.name: AlPagination
declarations.description: Lays out the previous and next links of a paged list, with "Page N of M" between them; the app renders the links.

attributes.name: page
attributes.description: The current page, from 1. With `pages`, shown as "Page 2 of 5" between the links.

attributes.name: pages
attributes.description: The number of pages.

slots.name: prev
slots.description: The link to the previous page (or a `<span aria-disabled="true">` on the first page).
Optional middle content, such as your own "Page 2 of 5" text or page links; when present it replaces the generated text. Added in v0.1.1.

slots.name: next
slots.description: The link to the next page (or a `<span aria-disabled="true">` on the last page).

declarations.name: AlStack
declarations.description: Lays its children out in a column or a wrapping row, with a gap.

attributes.name: gap
attributes.description: The space between the children: `sm`, `md` or `lg`.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: The stacking direction: `column` (top to bottom) or `row` (left to right, wrapping).

declarations.name: AlPage
declarations.description: The page's content frame: a centred column of a set maximum width.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: The frame's maximum width: `narrow` (40rem), `normal` (56rem) or `wide` (80rem).

declarations.name: AlDialog
declarations.description: A modal dialog: wraps a native `<dialog>` that the author writes (Alder's renderer writes it for you, including the heading and the close button; other stacks write the `<dialog>` themselves, and the stylesheet styles both the bare `<dialog>` and the markup Alder emits). The platform supplies the focus trap, the inert page, Escape and return focus. Open it with `<button commandfor="id" command="show-modal">` (al-shim.js polyfills invoker commands on older browsers). With no JavaScript, link to `#id`: the dialog is shown, not modal, and `#` hides it.

attributes.name: heading
attributes.description: The dialog's heading. The framework renders it as the `header` slot's `<h2>`; the attribute itself draws nothing.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The dialog's width.

attributes.name: dismissible
attributes.description: Makes room for a close button: a `<form method="dialog">` holding a `<button>` as the first child of the `<dialog>`.

slots.name: actions
slots.description: The buttons along the bottom, right-aligned.

events.name: al-close
events.description: Fired (bubbles) on the al-dialog when its dialog closes, however it closed.

declarations.name: AlPopover
declarations.description: A small floating panel anchored to the button that opens it. Write `popover` on it and open it with `popovertarget="id"` or `commandfor="id" command="toggle-popover"` on a button; this works with no JavaScript. Placement uses CSS anchor positioning, flipping to the other side when it would overflow.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Which side of the anchor the popover opens on.

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: The gap between the anchor and the popover.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: The id of the element to anchor to, when it is not the invoker (the platform's `anchor` attribute).

events.name: al-close
events.description: Fired (bubbles) on the al-popover when it closes.

declarations.name: AlMenu
declarations.description: A menu: a popover of links or buttons. Open it with `<button commandfor="id" command="toggle-popover">`. Without JavaScript it is a popover of links (which still navigate); `al-menu.js` adds the `menu` / `menuitem` roles, roving arrow keys, Home/End, and closes on select.

events.name: al-select
events.description: Fired (bubbles) on the al-menu when an item is chosen; `detail.item` is the item.

events.name: al-close
events.description: Fired (bubbles) on the al-menu when it closes.

declarations.name: AlTabs
declarations.description: Tabs backed by a radio group: selection and arrow keys work with no JavaScript. Children are `<al-tab>`s; each holds a `<label>` wrapping a radio input (same `name`, one `checked`) and its `<al-panel>`. `al-tabs.js` builds the tabs ARIA pattern: a `<div role="tablist">` of `<button role="tab">` (with `aria-selected`, `aria-controls` and a roving `tabindex`) made from the labels' text and placed before the panels, the radio labels hidden, each panel given `role="tabpanel"`, an `id` and `aria-labelledby`; it also adds arrow keys, Home/End, `selected`, and the `al-select` event.

events.name: al-select
events.description: Fired (bubbles) on the al-tabs when a tab is chosen; `detail.tab` is the al-tab.

declarations.name: AlTab
declarations.description: One tab: a `<label>` wrapping a radio input, then its `<al-panel>`.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The radio group's name. al-tabs.js copies it onto a radio that has none.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: The tab the server picked; al-tabs.js checks its radio. (Without the script, write `checked` on the radio.)

declarations.name: AlPanel
declarations.description: A tab's content, shown when its tab is selected.

declarations.name: AlToast
declarations.description: A transient message in an `<al-toasts popover="manual">` region. `al-toast.js` shows the region when a toast connects, gives the toast `role="status"`, and closes it after `timeout` ms. Without JavaScript the region stays hidden; render the message as an `al-alert` in the page.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: The toast's look, like al-alert's.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Milliseconds before the toast closes; `0` keeps it until closed.

declarations.name: AlToasts
declarations.description: The region toasts appear in: a `popover="manual"` element in the top layer at a corner of the viewport. Put it outside any morphed region.

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: The corner of the viewport.

events.name: al-close
events.description: Fired (bubbles) on the region when a toast closes; `detail.toast` is the toast.

declarations.name: AlTooltip
declarations.description: A short text hint for the element whose id is in `for`. `al-tooltip.js` makes it a `popover="hint"` (a manual popover where `hint` is unknown), anchors it, sets `aria-describedby` on the trigger and shows it on hover and focus. Without JavaScript it stays hidden: also put the text in the trigger's `title`.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: The id of the element the tooltip describes.

declarations.name: AlDevpanel
declarations.description: The developer bar: a one-line bar sticky along the bottom of the page; with `open`, the selected section shows above it. Content is server-rendered markup: a `<nav>` of tab `<button>`s (`aria-controls` naming a section's id) and `<section>`s. `al-devpanel.js` hides the sections that are not selected, re-applies the selection after any DOM patch (a MutationObserver) so a server patching the panel's inner content need not render `hidden`, and toggles `open`; without it every section shows when open. SQL and code are monospace.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Shows the sections above the bar.

slots.description: A `<nav>` of tab buttons, then the `<section>`s.
